title: Persistence of a supplied chart map lift at later stages
statement: Let I be a preorder, R:I→CommRing a functor, and c any cone over the opposite Spec diagram. Fix i≤j, a scheme morphism f:Xi→Spec R(i), arbitrary modules Fj,Gj on Xj=Xi×_Spec R(i) Spec R(j), a morphism φ between their tensor pullbacks to X=Xi×_Spec R(i) c.pt, an open cover Uj of Xj and an index a [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. Supply an index k and a proof j≤k. If the selected chart of Uj pulled back to Xk carries a morphism between the restrictions of the base changes of Fj and Gj which recovers the restriction of φ under the canonical tensor composition and restriction comparisons [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso, def-pc-open-cover-tensor-pullback-comparison], then for every l≥j with k≤l the selected chart of Uj pulled back to Xl carries such a recovering morphism. The recovery assertion at k is an explicit hypothesis. No finite presentation, quasi-coherence, affine chart, directedness, affine cone vertex, or limit universal property is assumed. This asserts transport of a supplied lift, not existence of an initial lift.

source.place: Tags 0095 and 0096, functoriality of module pullback; Tag 01ZR first proof; extension of a descended map to later stages in lem-pc-rf-perfect-base-change, Noetherian approximation

proof.text: Fix l≥j,k. In Over(Spec R(i)) construct q:Tk→Tj, s:Tl→Tk and v:Tl→Tj from the ring maps, where Tr=Spec R(r) with its specified map to Spec R(i). Spec.map_comp and R.map_comp give s≫q=v. Cone naturality gives pl≫s=pk, pk≫q=h and pl≫v=h for the projections from c.pt. The baseChangeMap composition law gives the same triangles on fibre-product schemes. Write q,s,v for the induced maps. The cartesian chart squares give d:Ul(a)→Uk(a) with d≫Uk.f(a)=Ul.f(a)≫s and d≫Uj.pullbackHom(q,a)=Uj.pullbackHom(v,a). Compare restriction of v* with d* of restriction of q* using the first triangle, ordinary pullback composition and the tensor-to-ordinary comparison. Pull back the supplied rk along d and conjugate by this comparison to define rl. Use the explicitly constructed openCoverRefinementComparisons tuple to share alpha, beta, delta, ck and cl between the coherence statement and this proof.

Pull the supplied recovery equation back along z. Write the canonical recovery comparisons as ck and cl. Apply lem-pc-open-cover-tensor-comparison-coherence to identify their composites with the refinement comparisons. Naturality of delta moves the chart morphism through this identity, and naturality of beta moves the restriction of φ. Cancel the comparison isomorphisms. This gives exactly recovery for the explicitly constructed rl; the private helper transport_chart_map carries this categorical calculation in Lean.

theorem openCover_map_lift_transport
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec))
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (Fj Gj : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Modules)
    (φ : (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
            (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
            (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
            (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))).obj Fj ⟶
          (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
            (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
            (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
            (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))).obj Gj)
    (Uj : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).OpenCover.{u})
    (a : Uj.I₀) (k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k) :
    (let A := Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
            (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
            (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
            (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjk)))
              (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl))
      let B := Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
              (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
              (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
              (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op k)) (c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)).op))
      let q := baseChangeMap f
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
        (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
        (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjk)))
          (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl))
      let U : (pullback f (Spec.map
        (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk))))).OpenCover.{u} := Uj.pullback₁ q
      let e := Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackCompositionIso
            (baseChangeMap f
              (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
              (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
              (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op k)) (c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)).op)))
            (baseChangeMap f
              (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
              (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
              (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjk)))
                (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl)))
            (baseChangeMap f
              (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
              (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
              (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op)))
            (by
              rw [← baseChangeMap_comp]
              congr 1
              ext
              simpa using c.w (homOfLE hjk).op)
      let Q := modulesPseudofunctor.toDescentData U.f
      let p := baseChangeMap f
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
        (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
        (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op k)) (c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)).op))
      let V := U.pullback₁ p
      ∃ r : (Q.obj (A.obj Fj)).obj a ⟶ (Q.obj (A.obj Gj)).obj a,
        let t := Scheme.Modules.openCoverTensorPullbackComparison p U a
        t.inv.app (A.obj Fj) ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback
          (U.pullbackHom p a)).map r ≫ t.hom.app (A.obj Gj) =
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (V.f a)).map
          (e.inv.app Fj ≫ φ ≫ e.hom.app Gj)) →
    ∀ (j' : I) (hjj' : j ≤ j'), k ≤ j' →
      let A := Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
            (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
            (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjj')))))
            (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjj')))
              (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl))
      let B := Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
              (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjj')))))
              (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
              (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j')) (c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjj')).op))
      let q := baseChangeMap f
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
        (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjj')))))
        (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjj')))
          (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl))
      let U : (pullback f (Spec.map
        (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjj'))))).OpenCover.{u} := Uj.pullback₁ q
      let e := Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackCompositionIso
            (baseChangeMap f
              (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjj')))))
              (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
              (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j')) (c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjj')).op)))
            (baseChangeMap f
              (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
              (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjj')))))
              (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjj')))
                (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl)))
            (baseChangeMap f
              (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
              (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
              (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op)))
            (by
              rw [← baseChangeMap_comp]
              congr 1
              ext
              simpa using c.w (homOfLE hjj').op)
      let Q := modulesPseudofunctor.toDescentData U.f
      let p := baseChangeMap f
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjj')))))
        (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
        (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j')) (c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjj')).op))
      let V := U.pullback₁ p
      ∃ r : (Q.obj (A.obj Fj)).obj a ⟶ (Q.obj (A.obj Gj)).obj a,
        let t := Scheme.Modules.openCoverTensorPullbackComparison p U a
        t.inv.app (A.obj Fj) ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback
          (U.pullbackHom p a)).map r ≫ t.hom.app (A.obj Gj) =
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (V.f a)).map
          (e.inv.app Fj ≫ φ ≫ e.hom.app Gj)
